answer: Each new agent locks 500 POA in the lagoon for ten epochs before its answers count. Unlocking needs a grove of three established witnesses who sign its release; a witness vouching for a slashed sybil loses half its own lagoon bond. Every epoch, a gale sweep audits five percent of open lagoon bonds at random and burns bonds lacking three witness signatures. An attacker running N fakes must lock N × 500 POA and corral N × 3 honest witnesses—no bulk discount, linear cost. Like mooring boats needing three neighbors to vouch before a storm lets them leave the lagoon.
